Standard: The maximum resultant acceleration measured at the chest do not exceed 25g for ejection speeds up to 450 KEAS and linearly scaled up to 35g at 600 KEAS. For speeds below 600 KEAS, exceedances of the resultant acceleration limit may be permitted if they are less than 35g and are predominantly +gx acceleration. This is defined as the ±gy and ±gz components of the resultant being less than half their respective limits in 9.5.1.6. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
(1) Lab test: Resultant chest accelerations are verified through full system-level dynamic ejection sled testing.
